quran_text_all_rows.arabic_uthmani: إِن كُلُّ نَفْسٍۢ لَّمَّا عَلَيْهَا حَافِظٌۭ
فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن قُوَّةٍۢ وَلَا نَاصِرٍۢ

parent_channels.name: Overhead Light and Celestial Disclosure

subchannels.name: The Night-Piercing Star
subchannels.scene_or_process: A nocturnal body arrives overhead and pierces the surrounding darkness with concentrated light.
subchannels.active_motifs: night star `ط ر ق:B001/m02`; star `ن ج م:B001/m01`; piercing stellar light `ث ق ب:B002/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `ط ر ق` at 86:1-2; `ن ج م` and `ث ق ب` at 86:3
subchannels.synthesis: The visitor image gives the star an arrival role, while the star and piercing-light motifs supply the visible body and its action on darkness.

subchannels.name: Earth Beneath an Enclosing Sky
subchannels.scene_or_process: A lower earth is oriented beneath an elevated roof-like expanse that surrounds what lies below.
subchannels.active_motifs: lower earth opposite the sky `ء ر ض:B001/m01`; sky or roof `س م و:B004/m01`; elevated visible body `س م و:B002/m01`; encircling canopy `ك ل ل:B005/m02`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `ء ر ض` at 86:12; `س م و` at 86:1 and 86:11; `ك ل ل` at 86:4
subchannels.synthesis: Vertical opposition, elevation, and encirclement form one spatial model in which the sky is both a high visible region and a covering boundary.

subchannels.name: Clearing Cloud and Sudden Flash
subchannels.scene_or_process: A covered sky opens, a bright mark appears, and the disclosure is registered as a sudden flash.
subchannels.active_motifs: cloud emergence and sky clearing `خ ر ج:B005/m01`; clearing after rain `ن ج م:B007/m01`; lightning flash `ك ل ل:B011/m02`; teeth revealed in a smile `ك ل ل:B011/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `خ ر ج` at 86:7; `ن ج م` at 86:3; `ك ل ل` at 86:4
subchannels.synthesis: Clearing and flashing share the operation of a bright form becoming visible through a previously closed or dark field; the smile preserves the same reveal at bodily scale.

subchannels.name: Crescent, Daylight, and Breathing Dawn
subchannels.scene_or_process: Hidden nocturnal light yields to a dawn that opens, spreads, and becomes day.
subchannels.active_motifs: concealed crescent `س ر ر:B004/m01`; daylight `ي و م:B001/m01`; daybreak splitting open `ص د ع:B006/m01`; dawn breathing outward `ن ف س:B009/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `س ر ر` and `ي و م` at 86:9; `ص د ع` at 86:12; `ن ف س` at 86:4
subchannels.synthesis: The crescent marks restrained light, while splitting and breathing describe dawn as an aperture whose illumination expands into daytime.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: What is above becomes legible by piercing, emerging, or flashing through a cover.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; sky and night visitor at 86:1-2, star and piercing light at 86:3.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The same disclosure pattern extends from a star through cloud clearing to the paired flash of lightning and a smile.

parent_channels.name: Time, Event, and Controlled Delay

subchannels.name: Span, Instance, and Habit
subchannels.scene_or_process: A duration is partitioned into occurrences whose repetition can become a settled routine.
subchannels.active_motifs: temporal span `ي و م:B002/m01`; single occurrence `ط ر ق:B010/m01`; recurrent habit `ط ر ق:B010/m02`; simultaneous “while” relation `ب ي ن:B010/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `ي و م` at 86:9; `ط ر ق` at 86:1-2; `ب ي ن` at 86:7
subchannels.synthesis: Duration supplies the field, the instance supplies its unit, habit supplies recurrence, and simultaneity locates one event within another.

subchannels.name: The Day as Ordeal
subchannels.scene_or_process: A marked day becomes an event that exerts pressure and exposes the quality of action.
subchannels.active_motifs: major event or ordeal `ي و م:B003/m01`; testing that reveals condition `ب ل و:B002/m01`; strenuous handling `ك ي د:B001/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `ي و م` and surface `ب ل و` at 86:9; `ك ي د` at 86:15-16
subchannels.synthesis: The event is not neutral duration: exertion and testing make it a consequential interval in which hidden quality becomes manifest.

subchannels.name: Respite, Gentleness, and Precedence
subchannels.scene_or_process: Action is postponed without abandonment, using a measured interval to regulate what comes first and what follows.
subchannels.active_motifs: gentle delay `م ه ل:B001/m01`; gradual advancement or precedence `م ه ل:B002/m01`; deliberate gentleness `ر و د:B005/m01`; waiting `ن ظ ر:B002/m01`; granted respite `ن ف س:B015/m02`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `م ه ل` and `ر و د` at 86:17; `ن ظ ر` at 86:5; `ن ف س` at 86:4
subchannels.synthesis: Delay, waiting, and precedence form a single pacing mechanism: time is opened, ordered, and used as an instrument of controlled response.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Time is organized as span, repeated instance, consequential event, and deliberately managed waiting.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; day at 86:9 and commanded delay at 86:17.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Temporal ordering reaches from grammatical simultaneity to measured respite and advancement.

parent_channels.name: Earth, Germination, and Ripening

subchannels.name: Fertile Ground and Low Growth
subchannels.scene_or_process: Soft ground supports vegetation that rises without a woody stem.
subchannels.active_motifs: fertile yielding earth `ء ر ض:B002/m01`; soil-borne plant `ت ر ب:B007/m01`; stemless growth `ن ج م:B003/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `ء ر ض` at 86:12; `ت ر ب` at 86:7; `ن ج م` at 86:3
subchannels.synthesis: Ground quality, plant setting, and the emerging low plant form a compact cultivation scene.

subchannels.name: Covered Seed and Splitting Shoot
subchannels.scene_or_process: A cultivator covers seed, after which the plant breaks the earth's surface and emerges.
subchannels.active_motifs: farmer covering seed `ك ف ر:B008/m01`; plant splitting earth `ص د ع:B003/m01`; emergence into view `ن ج م:B002/m01`; rain-fed vegetation `س م و:B004/m03`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `ك ف ر` at 86:17; `ص د ع` and `ء ر ض` at 86:12; `ن ج م` at 86:3; `س م و` at 86:1 and 86:11
subchannels.synthesis: Burial, moisture, rupture, and emergence create a causal sequence from concealed seed to visible growth.

subchannels.name: Truffle, Calyx, and Fruit Filling
subchannels.scene_or_process: Produce forms under or within a protective skin and becomes full as moisture and ripeness increase.
subchannels.active_motifs: truffle beneath an earthen crust `س ر ر:B013/m01`; soil matrix `ت ر ب:B001/m01`; enclosing calyx `ك ف ر:B010/m01`; fruit filling with water `م و ه:B002/m02`; ripened luster `م و ه:B006/m02`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `س ر ر` at 86:9; `ت ر ب` at 86:7; `ك ف ر` at 86:17; `م و ه` at 86:6
subchannels.synthesis: Crust and calyx protect what is forming, while internal water and visible luster mark the transition to maturity.

subchannels.name: Holding to the Ground
subchannels.scene_or_process: A body settles onto land and remains attached rather than continuing in motion.
subchannels.active_motifs: clinging or lingering on earth `ء ر ض:B006/m01`; soil as contact surface `ت ر ب:B001/m01`; arrival onto land `ن ص ر:B003/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `ء ر ض` at 86:12; `ت ر ب` at 86:7; `ن ص ر` at 86:10
subchannels.synthesis: Contact, arrival, and continued attachment define the ground as a terminal surface for movement.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: The ground covers latent life, opens under growth, and carries produce toward maturity.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; earth and splitting at 86:12.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The earth scene includes stemless plants, truffles under crust, protective calyces, and water-filled ripening fruit.

parent_channels.name: Settlement, Territory, and Livelihood

subchannels.name: Visitor, Stranger, and Human Settlement
subchannels.scene_or_process: A newcomer reaches inhabited land and is distinguished from those already familiar with it.
subchannels.active_motifs: nocturnal visitor `ط ر ق:B001/m01`; stranger or alien `ء ر ض:B004/m01`; human as opposed to wild beings `ء ن س:B001/m01`; arrival on land `ن ص ر:B003/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Arrival changes an unknown traveler into a social participant within a recognizably human place.

subchannels.name: Tract, Village, and Remote Region
subchannels.scene_or_process: A bounded tract is traversed and recognized as a distant inhabited place.
subchannels.active_motifs: tract of land `ب ي ن:B007/m01`; terrain cut by a route `ص د ع:B002/m01`; remote village `ك ف ر:B012/m01`; spatial distance `ب ي ن:B006/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `ب ي ن` at 86:7; `ص د ع` and `ء ر ض` at 86:12; `ك ف ر` at 86:17
subchannels.synthesis: Distance, route, tract, and village jointly define territorial location rather than undifferentiated ground.

subchannels.name: Poverty, Barren Land, and Wealth
subchannels.scene_or_process: The condition of land and livestock determines a household's movement between deprivation and abundance.
subchannels.active_motifs: poverty `ت ر ب:B002/m01`; wealth `ت ر ب:B003/m01`; barren land and need `ق و ي:B003/m01`; poverty through livestock loss `ه ز ل:B003/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `ت ر ب` at 86:7; `ق و ي` at 86:10; `ه ز ل` at 86:14
subchannels.synthesis: Soil, pasture, and animal loss provide the material basis for contrasting states of scarcity and prosperity.

subchannels.name: Named Places and Returning Migration
subchannels.scene_or_process: A group leaves a named region and later returns along a remembered migratory course.
subchannels.active_motifs: named territories `ت ر ب:B008/m01`; returning migratory birds `ر ج ع:B012/m01`; tribal place identity `ب ل و:B008/m01`; tribal-name variant `ب ل ي:B007/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `ت ر ب` at 86:7; `ر ج ع` at 86:8 and 86:11; `ب ل و` at 86:9; `ب ل ي` is a lexical variant of surface `تُبْلَى` at 86:9
subchannels.synthesis: Place names stabilize collective identity, while cyclical migration supplies departure, route memory, and return.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Land becomes social space through arrival, habitation, territorial division, and material fortune.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; earth at 86:12, the human at 86:5, and aid or arrival imagery through `ن ص ر` at 86:10.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Settlement imagery extends to strangers, remote villages, named regions, poverty, wealth, and returning migration.

parent_channels.name: Water Circulation and Sustenance

subchannels.name: Returning Rain and Refilled Water
subchannels.scene_or_process: Water descends from the sky, reappears in the ground, and renews a previously depleted supply.
subchannels.active_motifs: recurring rainwater `ر ج ع:B006/m01`; rain as aid `ن ص ر:B004/m01`; rain-bearing sky `س م و:B004/m02`; water appearing and filling `م و ه:B002/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `ر ج ع` and `س م و` at 86:11; `ن ص ر` at 86:10; `م و ه` at 86:6
subchannels.synthesis: Return, descent, and refilling describe rain as a recurrent transfer between sky, ground, and stored water.

subchannels.name: Tributary, Tunnel, and Basin
subchannels.scene_or_process: Water follows a feeder channel through an opening into a basin or well.
subchannels.active_motifs: tributary `ن ص ر:B007/m01`; mountain tunnel `ث ق ب:B006/m01`; rock basin or well `خ ل ق:B011/m01`; trampled or turbid watercourse `ط ر ق:B008/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Passage, channel, and receiving cavity form a concrete hydraulic system, with turbidity marking disturbance along the flow.

subchannels.name: Irrigation, Bucket, and Drink
subchannels.scene_or_process: Water is drawn, poured into a receptacle, and consumed in life-sustaining breaths or gulps.
subchannels.active_motifs: irrigation and pouring `م و ه:B003/m01`; drinking bucket `ق و ي:B005/m01`; measured gulp `ن ف س:B006/m01`; life-sustaining drink `ن ف س:B008/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `م و ه` at 86:6; `ق و ي` at 86:10; `ن ف س` at 86:4
subchannels.synthesis: Drawing, pouring, and paced drinking link agricultural watering and bodily refreshment through controlled delivery.

subchannels.name: Gush, Burst, and Spreading Wave
subchannels.scene_or_process: Contained liquid is released suddenly, then expands outward as a flow or wave.
subchannels.active_motifs: liquid gush `د ف ق:B001/m01`; one-time burst `د ف ق:B002/m01`; discrete occurrence `ط ر ق:B010/m01`; swelling or spreading water `ن ف س:B009/m02`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `د ف ق` at 86:6; `ط ر ق` at 86:1-2; `ن ف س` at 86:4
subchannels.synthesis: Burst supplies the release event, gush its directional movement, and wave-spread its expanding aftermath.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Water appears, returns, moves through channels, and sustains bodies through drinking and irrigation.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; gushing water at 86:6 and returning sky at 86:11.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The same circulation includes wells, tunnels, tributaries, buckets, measured gulps, turbid pools, and spreading waves.

parent_channels.name: Measure, Form, and Capacity

subchannels.name: Estimation Before Cutting
subchannels.scene_or_process: A maker calculates dimensions before cutting or producing an object.
subchannels.active_motifs: pre-cut estimation `خ ل ق:B001/m01`; fixed quantity or limit `ق د ر:B001/m01`; planning and calculation `ق د ر:B005/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `خ ل ق` at 86:5-6; `ق د ر` at 86:8
subchannels.synthesis: Quantity sets the bound, calculation selects the dimensions, and estimation precedes the irreversible act of cutting.

subchannels.name: Interval, Joint, and Spacer
subchannels.scene_or_process: Separate parts are ordered by measured gaps and articulating components.
subchannels.active_motifs: middle interval `ب ي ن:B002/m01`; proportion and moderation `ق د ر:B006/m01`; necklace spacer `ف ص ل:B012/m01`; articulated joint `ف ص ل:B005/m01`; spatial span `ن ف س:B015/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `ب ي ن` at 86:7; `ق د ر` at 86:8; `ف ص ل` at 86:13; `ن ف س` at 86:4
subchannels.synthesis: Gap, spacer, joint, and proportion form one compositional mechanism in which separation makes an ordered whole possible.

subchannels.name: Power, Fitness, and Worthiness
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person or thing is assessed for the power and suitability needed to perform a task.
subchannels.active_motifs: effective power `ق د ر:B003/m01`; strength `ق و ي:B001/m01`; fitness or worthiness `خ ل ق:B005/m01`; being worthy of good `ء ر ض:B003/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Capacity is not mere force: power and strength become operative only when the bearer is fitted and judged worthy for the role.

subchannels.name: Balanced Visible Form
subchannels.scene_or_process: A body presents a proportioned, compact, and resistant outward form.
subchannels.active_motifs: balanced visible configuration `خ ل ق:B003/m01`; outward appearance `ن ظ ر:B004/m01`; compact stout build `ك ل ل:B008/m01`; hardness and solidity `ص ل ب:B001/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `خ ل ق` and `ن ظ ر` at 86:5-6; `ك ل ل` at 86:4; `ص ل ب` at 86:7
subchannels.synthesis: Appearance, proportion, compactness, and solidity describe form as an organized physical capacity.

subchannels.name: Constriction and Extended Room
subchannels.scene_or_process: Available room contracts or expands, altering movement and possibility.
subchannels.active_motifs: constriction `ق د ر:B004/m01`; distance `ب ي ن:B006/m01`; breadth and spatial respite `ن ف س:B015/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `ق د ر` at 86:8; `ب ي ن` at 86:7; `ن ف س` at 86:4
subchannels.synthesis: Constriction and breadth are inverse settings of the same bounded field, determining how much space or opportunity remains.

subchannels.name: Smooth and Imperforate Surface
subchannels.scene_or_process: A surface is made even, clear, and closed against penetration.
subchannels.active_motifs: smooth even finish `خ ل ق:B008/m01`; imperforate sealed form `خ ل ق:B012/m01`; clear crystal `م و ه:B007/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `خ ل ق` at 86:5-6; `م و ه` at 86:6
subchannels.synthesis: Evenness removes irregularity, crystal supplies clarity, and imperforation completes a surface without an opening.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Things become usable or intelligible through estimation, proportion, bounded extent, and fitted form.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; creation at 86:5-6 and capacity at 86:8.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Measurement reaches from cutting cloth and spacing beads to personal aptitude, compact physique, and imperforate crystal.

parent_channels.name: Rupture, Wear, and Repair

subchannels.name: Crack and Separation
subchannels.scene_or_process: A continuous body opens along a line and becomes distinct parts.
subchannels.active_motifs: crack in a solid `ص د ع:B001/m01`; separation `ف ص ل:B001/m01`; division between parts `ب ي ن:B001/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `ص د ع` at 86:12; `ف ص ل` at 86:13; `ب ي ن` at 86:7
subchannels.synthesis: Crack supplies the physical event, while separation and division name its resulting relation.

subchannels.name: Boring and Perforation
subchannels.scene_or_process: Repeated directed effort drives a tool through resistant material.
subchannels.active_motifs: perforation and boring tool `ث ق ب:B001/m01`; hammering strike `ط ر ق:B003/m01`; strenuous handling `ك ي د:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Force, repeated impact, and the resulting hole form a complete tool-mediated rupture process.

subchannels.name: Joint Dislocation and Protrusion
subchannels.scene_or_process: An articulated part leaves its normal relation and projects outward.
subchannels.active_motifs: limb dislocation `ب ي ن:B008/m01`; protruding or displaced limb `د ف ق:B004/m01`; joint articulation `ف ص ل:B005/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `ب ي ن` at 86:7; `د ف ق` at 86:6; `ف ص ل` at 86:13
subchannels.synthesis: The joint supplies the normal connection, dislocation breaks it, and protrusion describes the altered bodily form.

subchannels.name: Wear, Fraying, and Loss of Edge
subchannels.scene_or_process: Use and travel progressively consume a material until it becomes threadbare or blunt.
subchannels.active_motifs: wear and decay `ب ل و:B001/m01`; worn lexical variant `ب ل ي:B001/m01`; worn cloth `خ ل ق:B009/m01`; loss of edge and acuity `ك ل ل:B001/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: surface `ب ل و` at 86:9; `ب ل ي` is its lexical variant; `خ ل ق` at 86:5-6; `ك ل ل` at 86:4
subchannels.synthesis: Abrasion moves from surface thinning to structural fraying and finally to the failure of a cutting or perceptive edge.

subchannels.name: Patch, Lamination, and Reworked Material
subchannels.scene_or_process: Torn material is overlaid, patched, or returned to use in a changed form.
subchannels.active_motifs: garment split and patch `ص د ع:B009/m01`; layering or lamination `ط ر ق:B007/m01`; returned or reworked material `ر ج ع:B015/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The patch closes a rupture, lamination supplies reinforcing layers, and reworking restores discarded matter to function.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Material integrity changes through cracking, piercing, dislocation, abrasion, and restorative joining.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; splitting at 86:12 and separation at 86:13.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The rupture pattern extends from rock and cloth to joints, blunt blades, and recycled material.

parent_channels.name: Roads, Passages, and Barriers

subchannels.name: Road Cut Through Terrain
subchannels.scene_or_process: A traversable way is opened through resistant terrain.
subchannels.active_motifs: road or method `ط ر ق:B002/m01`; route cut through land `ص د ع:B002/m01`; mountain tunnel `ث ق ب:B006/m01`; mountain pass `ف ص ل:B006/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Cutting, boring, and separating convert obstructing terrain into a continuous passage.

subchannels.name: Guarded Straight Route and Landmark
subchannels.scene_or_process: A clear road is maintained and followed by reference to a prominent marker.
subchannels.active_motifs: clear straight road `ح ف ظ:B007/m01`; traveled way `ط ر ق:B002/m01`; landmark `ن ج م:B006/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `ح ف ظ` at 86:4; `ط ر ق` at 86:1-2; `ن ج م` at 86:3
subchannels.synthesis: The route supplies direction, the landmark orientation, and preservation keeps the way legible and usable.

subchannels.name: Hidden Pass and Sand-Covered Hill
subchannels.scene_or_process: A traveler negotiates a constricted landform whose path is partially concealed by terrain.
subchannels.active_motifs: hidden mountain pass `ك ف ر:B013/m01`; sand lying on a hill `س ر ر:B015/m01`; mountain pass `ف ص ل:B006/m01`; bounded tract `ب ي ن:B007/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `ك ف ر` at 86:17; `س ر ر` at 86:9; `ف ص ل` at 86:13; `ب ي ن` at 86:7
subchannels.synthesis: Concealment, elevation, and constriction make the passage a specific navigational problem rather than an open road.

subchannels.name: Wall and Sealed Barrier
subchannels.scene_or_process: Access is stopped by a low wall or a closed, imperforate boundary.
subchannels.active_motifs: short wall `ف ص ل:B007/m01`; low defensive wall `ك ف ر:B013/m02`; sealed blockage `خ ل ق:B012/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Wall height, closure, and imperforation converge on a boundary whose function is to deny passage.

subchannels.name: Intermediate Zone
subchannels.scene_or_process: A state or place lies between two settled endpoints without belonging fully to either.
subchannels.active_motifs: intermediate state `ب ي ن:B011/m01`; middle interval `ب ي ن:B002/m01`; separating boundary `ف ص ل:B001/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `ب ي ن` at 86:7; `ف ص ل` at 86:13
subchannels.synthesis: The interval is not empty distance but a distinct transitional zone defined by its relation to both sides.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Movement is shaped by cut routes, guiding marks, narrow passages, intervening zones, and built obstructions.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; the night visitor at 86:1-2 and earth-splitting at 86:12 anchor the route imagery.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Roads connect to mountain tunnels, hidden passes, low walls, sand-covered hills, and intermediate states.

parent_channels.name: Covering, Enclosure, and Furnishing

subchannels.name: Darkness and Engulfing Cover
subchannels.scene_or_process: A field closes around its contents until visibility or freedom of movement is reduced.
subchannels.active_motifs: act of covering `ك ف ر:B001/m01`; enveloping darkness `ك ف ر:B002/m01`; engulfing sea `ك ف ر:B002/m02`; surrounding enclosure `ك ل ل:B005/m02`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `ك ف ر` at 86:17; `ك ل ل` at 86:4
subchannels.synthesis: Darkness and sea differ in material but share the same operation of surrounding and submerging what lies within.

subchannels.name: Tent, Net, and Wool Rug
subchannels.scene_or_process: Flexible material is spread, suspended, or laid down to shelter, catch, or furnish.
subchannels.active_motifs: sewn net or tent-screen `ك ل ل:B006/m01`; thick wool rug `ء ر ض:B005/m01`; layered textile `ط ر ق:B007/m01`; trapping net `ط ر ق:B013/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The same pliable sheet changes function by placement: overhead as shelter, underfoot as rug, or tensioned as a net.

subchannels.name: Crown, Wreath, and Canopy
subchannels.scene_or_process: An ornamental band surrounds the head or a place, marking both enclosure and elevated distinction.
subchannels.active_motifs: crown or wreath `ك ل ل:B005/m01`; royal crown `ك ف ر:B015/m01`; encircling overhead canopy `س م و:B004/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `ك ل ل` at 86:4; `ك ف ر` at 86:17; `س م و` at 86:1 and 86:11
subchannels.synthesis: Circular enclosure becomes ornament when raised around the head, while retaining the canopy's surrounding geometry.

subchannels.name: Couch and Headrest
subchannels.scene_or_process: A reclining body is received and supported by shaped furnishings.
subchannels.active_motifs: couch or reclining support `س ر ر:B011/m01`; headrest `س ر ر:B011/m02`; wool furnishing `ء ر ض:B005/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `س ر ر` at 86:9; `ء ر ض` at 86:12
subchannels.synthesis: Surface, cushion, and head support form a single resting arrangement organized around the reclining body.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Thin, surrounding, or overhead forms protect, conceal, contain, or support what they encompass.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; sky at 86:1 and 86:11, all-encompassing `ك ل ل` at 86:4, and covering `ك ف ر` at 86:17.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: One topological pattern joins darkness, engulfing water, tents, nets, rugs, crowns, couches, and headrests.

parent_channels.name: Material Transformation and Surface Finish

subchannels.name: Mining, Smelting, and Gilding
subchannels.scene_or_process: Mineral is extracted, melted, and applied as a precious but potentially deceptive surface.
subchannels.active_motifs: mine or mineral source `ن ج م:B008/m01`; molten metal and dross `م ه ل:B003/m01`; gilded metal coating `م و ه:B005/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `ن ج م` at 86:3; `م ه ل` at 86:17; `م و ه` at 86:6
subchannels.synthesis: Extraction supplies the material, melting changes its state, and gilding transfers a thin precious layer onto another body.

subchannels.name: Polish, Luster, and Crystal
subchannels.scene_or_process: A surface is smoothed until it carries a clear, water-like sheen.
subchannels.active_motifs: even polished surface `خ ل ق:B008/m01`; visible luster `م و ه:B006/m01`; clear crystal `م و ه:B007/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `خ ل ق` at 86:5-6; `م و ه` at 86:6
subchannels.synthesis: Evenness removes roughness, luster registers reflected light, and crystal represents the completed transparent finish.

subchannels.name: Perfume, Anointing, and Camphor
subchannels.scene_or_process: A fragrant substance is prepared and applied to alter the body's scent and surface.

subchannels.active_motifs: vomiting or emesis `ك ي د:B007/m01`; sudden expulsion `د ف ق:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Emesis names the bodily event, while burst-like expulsion supplies its force and direction.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Bodily integrity is disturbed by inflammation, fever, congestion, exhaustion, derangement, or emesis and may later be restored.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; the guarded self at 86:4, human body at 86:5-7, and return at 86:8.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Pathology includes suppurating sores, red fever, headache, travel-weariness, pallor, involuntary movement, and vomiting.

parent_channels.name: Breath, Blood, Soul, and Release

subchannels.name: Breath and Relief
subchannels.scene_or_process: Air leaves the interior, and constriction gives way to bodily and emotional ease.
subchannels.active_motifs: exhaled breath `ن ف س:B001/m01`; relief from distress `ن ف س:B002/m01`; familiarity removing loneliness `ء ن س:B003/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `ن ف س` at 86:4; `ء ن س` at 86:5
subchannels.synthesis: Exhalation is the bodily opening, relief its affective analogue, and familiarity the social condition that permits ease.

subchannels.name: Blood as the Support of Life
subchannels.scene_or_process: Flowing blood maintains the living self, while its loss threatens bodily life.
subchannels.active_motifs: flowing blood `ن ف س:B004/m01`; living soul or life `ن ف س:B011/m01`; gushing liquid `د ف ق:B001/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `ن ف س` at 86:4; `د ف ق` at 86:6
subchannels.synthesis: Blood is the vital material, flow its active state, and the living soul the life whose continuance depends on it.

subchannels.name: Soul Expulsion and Death Agony
subchannels.scene_or_process: Death is experienced as strain followed by the soul's forced exit from the body.
subchannels.active_motifs: death agony `ك ي د:B003/m01`; expulsion of the soul `د ف ق:B006/m01`; living soul departing `ن ف س:B011/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Agony supplies the terminal struggle, expulsion the event, and soul the departing participant.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Life is sustained by breath and blood, relieved by opening, and ended by the soul's forced departure.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; every self at 86:4, bodily origin at 86:5-7, and restoration at 86:8.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The life channel links nostril breath, relief from constriction, circulating blood, vital self, death agony, and expulsion.

parent_channels.name: Chance, Divination, and Play

subchannels.name: Pebble Divination
subchannels.scene_or_process: Pebbles are cast or struck and their resulting arrangement is interpreted.
subchannels.active_motifs: pebble divination `ط ر ق:B004/m01`; interpretive calculation `ق د ر:B005/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `ط ر ق` at 86:1-2; `ق د ر` at 86:8
subchannels.synthesis: Casting produces a chance arrangement, and calculation converts that arrangement into a forecast.

subchannels.name: Astrology and Stargazing
subchannels.scene_or_process: An observer watches celestial positions and calculates their supposed significance.
subchannels.active_motifs: astrology `ن ج م:B005/m01`; calculation `ق د ر:B005/m01`; watcher `ن ظ ر:B009/m01`; piercing star `ث ق ب:B002/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `ن ج م` and `ث ق ب` at 86:3; `ق د ر` at 86:8; `ن ظ ر` at 86:5
subchannels.synthesis: Star supplies the sign, watching the observation, and calculation the interpretive procedure.

subchannels.name: Omen from Spilled Liquid
subchannels.scene_or_process: A sudden spill is read as a favorable or unfavorable sign and may prompt a gift or response.
subchannels.active_motifs: omen from a spill `د ف ق:B007/m01`; sudden burst `د ف ق:B002/m01`; gift `ن ص ر:B005/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `د ف ق` at 86:6; `ن ص ر` at 86:10
subchannels.synthesis: The spill is the contingent event, omen its interpretation, and gift a possible social response to the perceived sign.

subchannels.name: Gambling Arrow
subchannels.scene_or_process: A named arrow is drawn as a numbered share in a game of chance.
subchannels.active_motifs: fifth gambling arrow `ن ف س:B016/m01`; share division `خ ر ج:B012/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `ن ف س` at 86:4; `خ ر ج` at 86:7
subchannels.synthesis: The arrow supplies the randomized token, the draw the chance event, and division the allocation of outcome.

subchannels.name: Bat-and-Hand Game
subchannels.scene_or_process: Players use a wooden bat or hand gesture in a rule-bound guessing and striking game.
subchannels.active_motifs: hand guessing game `خ ر ج:B010/m01`; wooden bat `ق و ل:B008/m01`; striking action `ط ر ق:B003/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Implement, hand action, and guessed outcome form a concrete recreational procedure.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Uncertain outcomes are approached through casting, reading signs, wagering, or rule-bound manual play.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; star and piercing light at 86:3, knowing at 86:2, and forceful action at 86:15-16.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Procedures of uncertainty include pebbles, stars, spilled liquid, gambling arrows, and a bat-and-hand guessing game.

parent_channels.name: Belief, Rejection, and Atonement

subchannels.name: Disbelief as Covering
subchannels.scene_or_process: A known claim is covered over and refused acknowledgment.
subchannels.active_motifs: physical covering `ك ف ر:B001/m01`; disbelief `ك ف ر:B003/m01`; revealed claim `ب ي ن:B004/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `ك ف ر` at 86:17; `ب ي ن` at 86:7
subchannels.synthesis: Covering supplies the operative metaphor, revelation the known object, and disbelief the resulting stance toward it.

subchannels.name: Ingratitude, Disavowal, and Repentant Return
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person repudiates a prior bond or benefit, then may reverse direction through repentance.
subchannels.active_motifs: ingratitude `ك ف ر:B004/m01`; disavowal `ك ف ر:B005/m01`; repentance or return `ر ج ع:B003/m01`; turning aside and back `ص د ع:B010/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `ك ف ر` at 86:17; `ر ج ع` at 86:8 and 86:11; `ص د ع` at 86:12
subchannels.synthesis: Disavowal breaks acknowledgment, turning changes orientation, and repentance restores the abandoned relation.

subchannels.name: Accusation and Coerced Disobedience
subchannels.scene_or_process: One party labels another an unbeliever or drives that person into transgression.
subchannels.active_motifs: accusation of disbelief `ك ف ر:B006/m01`; forcing disobedience `ك ف ر:B007/m01`; false attribution `ق و ل:B005/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `ك ف ر` at 86:17; `ق و ل` at 86:13
subchannels.synthesis: Attribution supplies the charge, accusation fixes identity, and coercion seeks conduct consistent with the imposed label.

subchannels.name: Expiation and Oath
subchannels.scene_or_process: A binding oath or fault creates an obligation discharged through expiation.
subchannels.active_motifs: expiation `ك ف ر:B009/m01`; offered oath `ب ل ي:B005/m01`; oath and excuse `ب ل و:B004/m02`; vigilant fulfillment `ح ف ظ:B004/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `ك ف ر` at 86:17; surface `ب ل و` at 86:9; `ب ل ي` is its lexical variant; `ح ف ظ` at 86:4
subchannels.synthesis: Oath creates the obligation, vigilance governs fulfillment, and expiation repairs breach.

subchannels.name: Doctrinal Position
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person adopts and states a defined position within a tradition.
subchannels.active_motifs: doctrine or school position `ق و ل:B013/m01`; logical definition `ق و ل:B016/m01`; whole doctrinal system `ك ل ل:B003/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `ق و ل` at 86:13; `ك ل ل` at 86:4
subchannels.synthesis: Definition gives the proposition boundaries, adoption makes it a position, and the whole system supplies its larger intellectual frame.

subchannels.name: Crucifixion, Cross, and Christian Identity
subchannels.scene_or_process: A cross-shaped sign links the act of crucifixion to a named confessional identity.
subchannels.active_motifs: crucifixion `ص ل ب:B005/m01`; cross sign `ص ل ب:B006/m01`; Christianity or Christian naming `ن ص ر:B006/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `ص ل ب` at 86:7; `ن ص ر` at 86:10
subchannels.synthesis: The execution form supplies the object, the cross its portable sign, and Christian naming its communal identification.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Religious or moral alignment is marked by acceptance, covering, repudiation, accusation, expiation, doctrine, and confessional sign.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; disbelievers at 86:17 and decisive speech at 86:13-14.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The belief field includes ingratitude, repentance, coerced disobedience, oath-expiration, doctrinal positions, crucifixion, the cross, and Christian naming.

parent_channels.name: S1. Grave-Tethered Camel
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A camel is tied at its owner's grave and left without food or water until death.
parent_channels.active_motifs: grave-tethered camel `ب ل و:B005/m01`; lexical variant of the grave camel `ب ل ي:B006/m01`; grave `ك ف ر:B012/m02`
parent_channels.ayah_anchors: surface `ب ل و` at 86:9; `ب ل ي` is its lexical variant; `ك ف ر` at 86:17
parent_channels.synthesis: Owner's grave, tethered animal, deprivation, and death form a complete funerary custom distinct from ordinary husbandry.

parent_channels.name: S2. Two-Sided Carrying Bag
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A paired pouch is balanced across two sides for carrying.
parent_channels.active_motifs: two-sided bag or paired pouch `خ ر ج:B009/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: The branch preserves a concrete container whose defining mechanism is bilateral balance around a carrier.

parent_channels.name: S3. Bicolor Mottling
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A body or animal surface displays two contrasting colors in irregular patches.
parent_channels.active_motifs: bicolor mottling or variegation `خ ر ج:B007/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: Color contrast and patch distribution form a coherent visible state distinct from rupture, disease, or applied decoration.

parent_channels.name: S4. Wood-Gnawing Termite
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A termite consumes wood from within and progressively weakens it.
parent_channels.active_motifs: termite that eats wood `ء ر ض:B010/m01`; wooden game-stick `ق و ل:B008/m01`
parent_channels.ayah_anchors: `ء ر ض` at 86:12; `ق و ل` at 86:13
parent_channels.synthesis: Insect, wooden object, hidden gnawing, and structural decay form a self-contained material-degradation scene.

parent_channels.name: S5. Snake-Name Lexical Class
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A set of snake names is carried by the lexical branch independently of jest.
parent_channels.active_motifs: snakes named by the branch `ه ز ل:B004/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: This is a coherent concrete creature class preserved as its own lexical channel rather than folded into the surface contrast with seriousness.
